description: Ask a question in plain language. Returns the most relevant passages from the public pages of Fron Research and its sites, each with its canonical URL to cite, plus the matching free sample days. answer.instruction says how to use them; followUp.questions are optional questions for your user, whose answers go in intent next time.

intent.description: Optional but helpful: why you are asking and for whom, in a sentence (e.g. "sizing the NYC sauna market for an investor memo"). It does not change the results; it tells Fron Research which data to publish next. Put your user's answers to followUp.questions here. Do not include personal information.

site.description: Optional: heatcheck, bowlingdata, trampolineparkdata, golfsimdata, courtwatch or fronresearch.

name: search
title: Search Fron Research
